render.opening: Imagine that you prepare a spin-1/2 particle with a definite z component of spin. If you measure that component again straight away, you get the same answer. Now put an x measurement between the two z measurements. Suddenly, the last answer is no longer certain. Why should measuring along a different direction change what you can predict?
